shell.guestDescription: Save your progress, exams and materials by adding your email address.

today.title: Plan for today
today.noSessionsDescription: Nothing planned for today. Add material or set an upcoming exam — the scheduler will plan reviews.
today.noActiveExam: No active deadline. Add an exam and the planner will schedule reviews automatically.
today.freeDayCopy: Nothing planned for today. Add an exam or check your materials, and the scheduler will plan reviews automatically.
today.planDoneCopy: You've completed everything for today. You can go back to materials or plan the next deadline.
today.catchUpCopy_one: You have {{count}} overdue review. The fastest way to get back on track is to start with it.
today.catchUpCopy_other: You have {{count}} overdue reviews. The fastest way to get back on track is to start with them.
today.nextStepExamCopy: {{examName}} is coming up. It's worth completing at least one session today to finish without stress.
today.nextStepTopicCopy: Start with {{topicName}}. It's the simplest way to get going without analyzing stats.
today.readyPlan: You have a plan for today
today.readyPlanCopy: Your plan is ready. Just start the first session and get into the rhythm.
today.overdueDescription: Start with the oldest item. It's the fastest way to organize your plan and reduce pressure before the next days.
today.sessionsRemaining_one: There's still {{count}} session left for today. It's good to complete at least the first one right away.
today.sessionsRemaining_other: There are still {{count}} sessions left for today. It's good to complete at least the first one right away.
today.planReady: Today's plan is ready. You can do a quick review or check the full schedule.

stats.title: Progress
stats.retentionExplanation: {{pct}}% of cards you remember on the first try. The goal is 90% — the closer you get, the less time you spend repeating the same cards.
stats.howWellYouKnow: How well you know your cards
stats.rememberLong: you'll remember them for a long time

browse.title: Your flashcards
browse.noCardsDescription: Add your first exam with topics, then create flashcards for studying. You can also add a flashcard manually.

review.doneDescription: Good job. We've scheduled the next reviews based on your ratings — "perfect" cards will come back later, difficult ones will return tomorrow.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.guestDescription: You are logged in as a guest. Add your email address to safely save your progress, exams and materials, and access them from any device.
profile.loginDescription: Enter the email address linked to your account. We'll send you a one-time link (Magic Link) to log in securely without a password.
profile.themeHint: Light or dark — choice is saved automatically.
profile.dataDescription: Your review history belongs to you. Download it anytime — JSON contains everything (cards, sessions, exams, ratings), CSV is just the rating history for spreadsheets.
profile.dangerZone: Deleting your profile is irreversible. All cards, sessions and progress will be permanently lost.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dailyLimitHint: Maximum number of new cards per day.

scanner.title: AI Scanner
scanner.cameraHint: Position the page in the frame. Best in good light without shadows.
scanner.desktopCameraHint: Take a photo of a note, page or slide. AI will convert it to text you can use in your flashcards.
scanner.desktopFileHint: Select photos of pages, notes or slides. AI will convert them to text you can use in your flashcards.
scanner.mobileFileHint: Already have photos on your phone?
scanner.mobileFileDescription: Select notes, pages or slides. The app will extract text from them.

exam.subject: Subject
exam.noSubjects: No subjects — add a new one to plan an exam.
exam.noResults: No results for the entered phrase.
exam.noTopics: No topics — add topics to generate a plan.
exam.noSlots: No available slots — fill in study hours in settings.

card.noTopics: No topics — add a new one to add a flashcard.
card.noTopicResults: No topics for the entered phrase.
card.frontPlaceholder: e.g. What are the properties of a quadratic function?

notes.newNoteDescription: Enter a topic and AI will prepare a comprehensive note
notes.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Properties of quadratic function, WWII — most important battles...
notes.step1: Enter a topic and optionally a subject
notes.step2: AI analyzes the topic and creates a note
notes.step3: The note is saved — you get a permanent link
notes.step4: Come back to it anytime, share with friends
notes.notFoundHint: Check if the link is correct, or generate a new one.

verify.justAMoment: This will only take a moment.
verify.checkLink: Make sure you're using the full link from the email.
verify.emailVerifiedDescription: Your account is now active. You can use the app on any device by logging in with this email address.

landing.heroDescription: Recurs combines flashcards, exam scheduler and AI-generated notes in one place. Track progress, review material and never be caught off guard on a test.
landing.oneEcosystem: One ecosystem for learning — from flashcards to exams and AI notes.
landing.examSchedulerDesc: Add exams and always see how many days are left until each deadline. Recurs will remind you when it's time to start reviewing.
landing.flashcardsDesc: Create flashcard sets for each subject and review material at your own pace.
landing.noteScannerDesc: Take a photo of your notebook notes — Recurs will turn them into digital flashcards ready for studying.
landing.studyStatsDesc: Track your progress in each subject and check which topics still need work.
landing.aiNotesDesc: Enter a topic and subject — Recurs will generate a concise note you can save and review before an exam.
landing.studyTimerDesc: Study with focus using the built-in timer with sessions and breaks.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.notificationsHint: Notifications about generated notes, scheduled sessions and other events will appear here.
